evidence: Carries the Validation label, edits Chainstate::FlushStateToDisk() in src/validation.cpp, and adds chainstate write tests.
rationale: Aborting FlushStateToDisk on block or undo flush failure protects chainstate integrity by preventing coins cache flushes and index marker advancement when block writes fail. As noted in the description, ignoring flush failures previously left 'on-disk chainstate and persistent indexes pointing to blocks whose underlying block data was never durably written to disk', which risks corruption when block storage encounters permanent fsync failures.
